content.title: "Chaos Rising" Preorders Finally Open on Pokemon Center, The Latest Ever for a Set - PokeBeach
content.text: #2 just got in line, GL everybody #3 Does anyone know when the Mega Zygarde premium boxes will be available to preorder? #4 Dunno if this is an unpopular opinion, but I like that preorders are only up now, after Perfect Order has had a little time to breathe. I really dislike preordering 2 sets ahead. #5 Strange that Pokemon Center didn't seem to send out promotional emails this time around. I don't see anything in my inbox announcing pre-orders are live. Usually the queue is hours long by the time I even get the email, but at least they have made an effort to inform people on the mailing list in the past. #6 I got through the queue and the website forced a reload #7 Strange that Pokemon Center didn't seem to send out promotional emails this time around. I literally only wait for the ETBs, I collect 1 and trade the extra for another I don't have or other products to collect.
